fact_text: A fertilizer maker should be assessed on gas price, urea demand, market share, production capacity and profit margin, since these drive its earnings.

fact_text: Refinery profits rise and fall with refining margins, so a refiner's earnings are most sensitive to changes in its margin per barrel processed.

fact_text: A stock tends to rise when earnings, revenue, profit margins and return on equity grow and debt is low; economic conditions such as lower interest rates and stable demand support higher valuations.

fact_text: An illustration with EPS rising from 10 to 15 and the share price rising from 100 to 180 shows how earnings growth can lift a stock's value; the figures are hypothetical.

fact_text: Higher interest rates raise financing costs and weigh on leveraged companies, while lower rates and stronger demand can support stock valuations.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'ChatGPT for PSX Investors: From Annual Reports to Portfolio Analysis. How I Use AI for Stocks!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An oil price shock hits companies with high petroleum or imported-energy exposure hardest, while currency pressure and higher energy costs affect importers and energy-heavy firms differently.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'ChatGPT for PSX Investors: From Annual Reports to Portfolio Analysis. How I Use AI for Stocks!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Review a portfolio by mapping each holding's exposure to oil prices, currency moves, energy costs and interest rates, which shows which holdings are most sensitive to each shock.

fact_text: The KSE-100 index tracks about 100 large listed Pakistani companies, while the KMI-30 index covers only Shariah-compliant companies.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'ChatGPT for PSX Investors: From Annual Reports to Portfolio Analysis. How I Use AI for Stocks!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An index can be approximated with its top-weighted stocks by scaling each stock's index weight by one common factor so the chosen holdings add up to about 100% of the portfolio.

fact_text: A portfolio of an index's largest holdings in index-weighted proportions should earn roughly the index return, since the same companies drive both.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'ChatGPT for PSX Investors: From Annual Reports to Portfolio Analysis. How I Use AI for Stocks!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Fundamental analysis studies a company's financial statements and ratios to judge its growth history and whether it is worth investing in, whereas technical analysis reads price charts alone.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'ChatGPT for PSX Investors: From Annual Reports to Portfolio Analysis. How I Use AI for Stocks!' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Most of a listed company's annual report can be skipped; the financial statements section (balance sheet, income statement, cash flow) holds the inputs needed for most ratios.

fact_text: Ratio comparisons between companies should use firms from the same sector, because sector economics shape the normal level of each ratio.
